tasks.title: Direct boss R6-B01 (shared; branch assignment provisional per route table): arena level, cinematics, sign-off
tasks.why: P2 + §7 Y5 Definition of Done: real art and audio, tuned on 5 difficulties

days.focus: R6-B01 (shared; branch assignment provisional per route table): approach level design and pacing
steps: Block out the approach to R6-B01 in the Cathedral Server chunk: last checkpoint, sightline to the arena, one rest point
Place an in-world warning before the trigger so the fight is never a surprise softlock
Check telegraph readability against the arena background with the art lead
Time the walk-back from checkpoint to boss; keep it short so retries stay fun
days.done: R6-B01 approach is blocked out and the checkpoint-to-boss time is logged

days.focus: R6-B01 (shared; branch assignment provisional per route table): intro and outro cinematic direction
steps: Storyboard CIN-R6-B01-IN and CIN-R6-B01-OUT (6-10 shots each) in `design/cinematics/r6_b01.md`
Write the camera timeline notes and hold lengths; mark the skip point
Brief the art lead (keyframes), audio (stingers) and writer (scene lines) with the shot list
Check the outro carries the outcome flags into the next scene
days.done: CIN-R6-B01-IN/OUT shot lists handed to art, audio and writing

days.focus: R6-B01 (shared; branch assignment provisional per route table): five-profile tuning sign-off
steps: Play R6-B01 on all 5 profiles with the difficulty tuning panel open
Check pattern literacy still matters on Beginner (§12.1: forgive execution, not attention)
Compare QA death logs with target ranges and adjust data, not code
Record the tuned values in the boss doc's Tuning Knobs section
days.done: R6-B01 tuning values recorded for all 5 profiles

days.focus: R6-B01 (shared; branch assignment provisional per route table): review team deliverables and sign off
steps: Review sprites, animation and VFX against the art bible; file numbered notes
Review the boss audio layer and telegraph SFX mix in the fight
Play the fight on Medium and on Hell with the latest build
Sign off or return with notes in `production/reviews/y5/r6_b01.md`
days.done: R6-B01 has a written sign-off or a dated return list

edge_cases: A telegraph is readable only by colour (fails colourblind modes)
Cinematic skipped on first view breaks a flag write
